text.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

words.gloss_range: delayed discourse transition into the inheritance clause
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) opens a new staged development after 35:31's settled divine-knowledge warrant. It scopes over the transfer of the Book, the recipients, and their selection as one inheritance event, while its full independent form carries more weight than the later clitic list-connectors.

topics.headline: staged inheritance transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah move from validated revelation into a deliberately staged allocation scene, not a loose continuation.
topics.reason: The particle is an independent conjunction before the main verbal clause, and the boundary rows tie it to 35:31 while distinguishing it from the later internal connectors.

words.gloss_range: Form IV completed divine causing of inheritance
words.root_gloss_range: succession, inheritance, legacy, and assigned custody; local Form IV makes God the causer of succession
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْرَثْنَا}} ({{tr:awrathnā}}) presents the Book-transfer as a completed divine assignment. Its Form IV profile makes the chosen group caused heirs, with the Book as the transferred object and the relative recipient as the caused heir; the inheritance image therefore reads as entrusted succession rather than self-acquired possession.

topics.headline: caused scriptural inheritance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees scripture as an assigned legacy and custody, while local syntax keeps the broad inheritance field focused on this divine transfer.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses two objects under the Form IV verb, and the root evidence supports succession/trust without requiring a death scene or land inheritance here.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative Book as the inherited object and known mandate
words.root_gloss_range: writing, inscription, prescription, joining, and fixed record; locally the known scripture as transferred mandate
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبَ}} ({{tr:al-kitāba}}) is the definite accusative object of the transfer. Its definiteness carries forward the Book just validated in 35:31, while the singular form and root field make the inheritance a coherent written mandate, not generic literacy or scattered duties.

topics.headline: validated Book becomes entrusted mandate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from revelation proven true in 35:31 to a known written trust handed to heirs in 35:32.
topics.reason: Case, definiteness, and boundary rows converge: the Book is the object transferred, and the root pressure is narrowed to an authoritative corpus and mandate.

words.gloss_range: plural relative recipient whose identity is delayed until selection
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) fills the recipient slot after the Book while making the listener wait for the relative clause. The heirs are not named first by ethnicity, rank, or later moral category; they are defined by the following divine selection.

topics.headline: delayed recipient identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inheritance is heard before the recipients are fully identified, and their identity is supplied by selection.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun functions as recipient of the transfer and object of the selection clause, so the later taxonomy cannot define the group before God does.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII completed divine selection from a servant field
words.root_gloss_range: clearness, choice, filtering, and selected purity; locally selection that does not erase later moral variance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱصْطَفَيْنَا}} ({{tr:iṣṭafaynā}}) matches the completed divine agency of the earlier transfer verb. The selection root gives the recipients qualitative chosen status, but the following repeated partitive clauses keep that status from meaning flawless sameness: the chosen are then internally classified.

topics.headline: chosen status before moral variance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the three classes as subdivisions of people already selected, not as groups competing to become selected.
topics.reason: The Form VIII selection is grammatically complete before the partitive taxonomy; root and recurrence evidence add chosen-quality pressure while local syntax limits it against perfectionism.

words.gloss_range: source and partitive preposition before the servant field
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) marks the selected heirs as drawn from the servant field. This first source phrase closes the recipient definition before the later pronoun-bound partitives begin sorting the group from within.

topics.headline: source field before taxonomy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes selection from a wider servant-domain from the later classification within the selected group.
topics.reason: The preposition is governed by the selection verb and the later forms shift to pronoun-bound internal partition.

words.gloss_range: plural divine-servant source field under selection
words.root_gloss_range: service, worship, subjection, and formed obedience; locally servants under divine authority
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادِنَا}} ({{tr:ʿibādinā}}) names the source field as servants belonging to God. The plural construct lets later singular class labels divide members without dissolving their shared servant relation, and that relation anticipates the later dependence on permission.

topics.headline: servants under authority receive the trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heirs receive the Book as servants under authority, not as autonomous owners of a possession.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the source preposition and bound by the first-person plural suffix; root evidence supports service and authority, locally narrowed to the selected servant field.

words.gloss_range: explanatory connector launching the internal taxonomy
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns from transfer and selection into explanation. It attaches the first partitive clause directly to what came before, so the coming moral classes unpack the inherited group rather than introduce another population.

topics.headline: immediate explanatory subdivision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the taxonomy as the immediate unpacking of chosen inheritance.
topics.reason: The prefixed connector begins the first fronted partitive nominal clause and is licensed by the explanatory link in the attachment profile.

words.gloss_range: first fronted partitive phrase inside the chosen group
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) fronts the partitive phrase before the first class label. The suffix keeps the self-wronger inside the already chosen recipients, and the form establishes the repeated template that will return for the middle and foremost classes.

topics.headline: self-wronging inside the heirs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even the negative first class is internal to the selected heirs, not outside the inheritance.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase creates a verbless class statement and the pronoun resumes the selected antecedent.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle for the self-wronging class
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, misplacement, darkness, and disorder; locally self-directed harm inside inherited guidance
words.prose: {{ar:ظَالِمٌ}} ({{tr:ẓālimun}}) names a representative class-character, not a named person or one-time event. The wronging root is turned inward by the following self-phrase, making the low pole of the triad a self-disordering misuse of inherited responsibility.

topics.headline: wronging turned inward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first class as active self-wronging within the heirs, the low pole of a rising moral scale.
topics.reason: The active participle is the delayed subject in the first partitive clause, and the following complement narrows broad wronging to self-directed harm.

words.gloss_range: lām complement directing wronging against the self
words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the self the affected domain of the participle. The compact prepositional link prevents the wronging from staying general; it routes the harm back to the person himself.

topics.headline: adverse direction to the self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the injustice is specifically directed back onto the actor.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following self noun and complements the active participle in a compact nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: possessed self as the inward victim/domain
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, person, breath, life, desire, and precious inward agency; locally the actor’s own self
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسِهِۦ}} ({{tr:nafsihi}}) closes the first class inward before the third class opens outward into goods. Its suffix returns to each representative wrongdoer, so actor and victim are compressed into one phrase; the broader self-life field makes the harm moral and existential, not merely social.

topics.headline: actor and victim compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees self-wronging as damage to the person’s own inward life and agency, in contrast to the third class’s outward goods.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the lām and carries a 3MS suffix referring back to the indefinite class label; root evidence is narrowed to inward selfhood.

words.gloss_range: coordinate connector adding the second class without sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the middle class as a coordinate member of the same list. It does not make moderation a result of self-wronging; it keeps the taxonomy structural rather than chronological.

topics.headline: coordinate middle class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the middle class as a parallel category, not an explanation or outcome of the first.
topics.reason: The conjunction links a second nominal partitive clause to the first without adding causal sequence.

words.gloss_range: second fronted partitive phrase with the same antecedent
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُم}} ({{tr:minhum}}) repeats the fronted partitive structure for the middle class. The same pronoun keeps moderation inside the chosen heirs and prevents the middle label from becoming an apposition to the self-wronger.

topics.headline: same group, separate middle class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the middle class as a separate internal partition of the same selected group.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition-plus-pronoun bundle preserves the antecedent while changing the class predicate.

words.gloss_range: indefinite participle naming measured directedness
words.root_gloss_range: aim, intention, straight heading, moderation, and measured course; locally purposeful middle response
words.prose: {{ar:مُّقْتَصِدٌ}} ({{tr:muqtaṣidun}}) names the center of the triad as a stable class-character. Its root field joins aim, straightness, and measured restraint, so the middle class is purposeful movement toward the inherited mandate rather than lukewarmness or a merely average midpoint.

topics.headline: purposeful middle course
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the middle category as disciplined direction within the inherited trust, not a weak compromise.
topics.reason: The indefinite participle is a nominative class label; q-ṣ-d evidence supports aim and moderation, locally narrowed to the middle response in the triad.

words.gloss_range: coordinate connector introducing the climactic final class
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the final, longer class inside the same coordinate list. The class can become climactic because it expands with two following phrases, but the connector prevents it from breaking away into a new sentence.

topics.headline: parallelism with climax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final class rise in weight while remaining one member of the same taxonomy.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the third partitive clause, and the following two prepositional phrases expand its predicate.

words.gloss_range: third fronted partitive phrase completing the refrain
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) completes the threefold partitive refrain. Even the foremost remain among the chosen servants, and the repeated template gives the taxonomy formal closure before the qualifiers and final verdict.

topics.headline: foremost still within the heirs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the highest class is not outside or above the inherited community but one internal partition of it.
topics.reason: The final pronoun resumes the same antecedent, preserving parallel syntax while allowing postposed qualifiers.

words.gloss_range: active participle for precedence bounded by goods and permission
words.root_gloss_range: preceding, racing, prior arrival, surpassing, and competition; locally ethical initiative under qualification
words.prose: {{ar:سَابِقٌ}} ({{tr:sābiqun}}) is the climactic class, but it is not bare superiority. The first following phrase supplies the goods-field and the second supplies divine permission; even the stronger reported racing pressure remains guarded by those limits.

topics.headline: climactic precedence under limits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the highest human response as ethical initiative in goods, not autonomous status superiority.
topics.reason: The active participle receives two postposed prepositional phrases; recurrence and variant evidence intensify precedence but local syntax restricts it by field and authorization.

words.gloss_range: first bāʾ marking the field or means of precedence
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) binds precedence to the goods-field. It names the arena or means of forwardness before the next matching particle names the enabling source, so the two identical particles create different dependencies.

topics.headline: field before authorization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that precedence is first tied to concrete goods before it is tied to permission.
topics.reason: The first preposition governs the goods noun and is distinct in scope from the following permission phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite plural goods as the arena of precedence
words.root_gloss_range: good, benefit, preference, choice, excellence, and valuable outcome; locally recognized beneficial deeds/outcomes
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-khayrāti}}) makes the arena of precedence definite, plural, and recognizable. The goods are many beneficial realizations, and the phrase echoes racing-to-goods language such as 2:148 while keeping this ayah’s class dependent on God’s leave.

topics.headline: plural goods as ethical arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the forerunner’s advance as directed toward recognized beneficial goods, not a vague claim to being better.
topics.reason: The noun is definite plural and genitive after the first bāʾ; root and formula evidence support beneficial choice, narrowed to the arena of the third class.

words.gloss_range: second bāʾ marking permission as operating condition
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) opens a second scope after the goods-field. Here it makes permission the operating condition of the forerunner’s excellence, not a decorative phrase appended after the real claim.

topics.headline: authorization as condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even the best class acts by enablement, not self-originated merit.
topics.reason: The second preposition governs the permission construct and most directly qualifies the final class.

words.gloss_range: construct verbal noun for divine authorization
words.root_gloss_range: ear, hearing, notice, announcement, leave, and permission; locally granted authorization as condition
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) is a construct head governed by the second permission-marking particle and completed by the divine name. Its hearing-and-notice root image becomes granted authorization, and as a verbal noun it states the condition under which precedence operates; the triad therefore closes with dependence before the final verdict begins.

topics.headline: permission bridges precedence and verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine authorization as the bridge between human precedence in goods and the naming of the whole reality as bounty.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after the preposition and construct-bound to God; root evidence adds hearing/authorization pressure while local form blocks a narrated request for permission.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name specifying the source of permission
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name and worship-authority field; locally the personal divine source of permission
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the permission construct and fixes its source personally and divinely. The actor implicit in the two earlier first-person plural verbs is now named just before the final evaluation, so transfer, selection, authorization, and bounty answer to one source.

topics.headline: explicit divine source before verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verdict is grounded in named divine authorization, not in social approval or human self-approval.
topics.reason: The proper name is genitive as the second term of the construct; derivational issues remain controlled by the proper-name function.

words.gloss_range: retrospective demonstrative gathering the preceding arrangement
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) gathers the preceding inheritance, selection, mixed triad, goods, and permission into one evaluable subject. Its singular pointing compresses the plural sequence and pivots the ayah from taxonomy into verdict.

topics.headline: complex sequence gathered for judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause evaluate the whole arranged reality, not only the third class in isolation.
topics.reason: The demonstrative begins the summarizing nominal clause and can point broadly over the full preceding sequence.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun of separation sharpening identification
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) sharpens the closing clause as identification. It separates the demonstrative from the bounty predicate, making the claim compact and emphatic: that arranged reality, precisely it, is the bounty.

topics.headline: emphatic identity hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verdict as an exact identification rather than a loose description.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun can function as separator or resumptive focus, and both readings strengthen predication without adding a new participant.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun identifying the arrangement as bounty
words.root_gloss_range: surplus, excess, favor, preference, and grace beyond baseline; locally granted bounty rather than merit ranking
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَضْلُ}} ({{tr:al-faḍlu}}) is the definite predicate that names the whole preceding arrangement as bounty itself. The surplus-favor root reframes inheritance, selection, internal variance, goods, and permission as granted overflow rather than a self-originating merit scale; the formula also recalls 62:4.

topics.headline: surplus favor names the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mixed taxonomy and authorized excellence evaluated as divine surplus favor, not as possession earned by the heirs.
topics.reason: Definite predicate syntax supports identification; root and formula evidence add surplus favor, narrowed away from another act of ranking.

words.gloss_range: definite qualitative adjective sealing the bounty as great
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, magnitude, gravity, seniority, and seriousness; locally stable weight attached to bounty
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَبِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-kabīru}}) agrees with the bounty phrase and seals the ayah with stable magnitude. The greatness belongs to divine bounty rather than human self-inflation or the forerunner’s ego, and the final word enlarges the verdict despite the mixed taxonomy.

topics.headline: final magnitude belongs to bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader ends with the scale of the gift, not with the defects or ranks of the human classes.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the definite predicate and closes the phrase; k-b-r evidence supports magnitude/gravity while local attachment keeps greatness modifying bounty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The transferred Book and the selected recipients are stated before the repeated internal partition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Transfer of a knowledge-bearing Book creates one selected recipient body; only afterward does the construction distribute that body's members among three positions. Receipt therefore precedes demonstrated performance.

activation_trace.role: Supplies transgenerational transfer of knowledge or scripture and makes common reception the mechanism's first step.
Supplies the written corpus that can pass from predecessors to a later body.
Supplies deliberate selection of the recipient set before its internal differentiation.
Supplies a shared relation of serving obedience that contains all three later positions.

changed_reading.before: The verse first appears to reward three already formed moral classes with different outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The verse first constitutes one selected inheriting body, then diagnoses three positions arising inside that common entrustment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The self-wronger, the directed moderate, and the one moving ahead are all grammatically related to the same inherited Book.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book supplies a binding norm. Relative to it, one member misplaces or withholds what is due from the self, one keeps a straight and measured course, and one advances through beneficial acts. The labels can therefore describe vectors of response rather than sealed castes.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an established norm against which the three responses become relationally legible.
Supplies misplacement in time or location as a functional account of the first response.
Supplies withholding a due right, here directed back toward the member's own self.
Fixes the affected object as the person's own concrete self rather than an abstract external victim.
Supplies straightness of route, making the middle position directed and stable rather than merely lukewarm.
Adds measured balance between excess and neglect to the middle course.
Supplies forward initiative and converts the third label into active movement.
Specifies beneficial good as the medium through which forward movement occurs.

changed_reading.before: The three nouns look like fixed identity labels arranged on a static ladder.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as three live orientations to one entrusted norm: self-defeating misplacement, measured direction, and beneficial advance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The selected set explicitly still contains a member who wrongs his own self.
baseline_models.mechanism: Selection extracts a set for a role, but the immediate internal contrast blocks equating selection with completed moral purity. The chosen status can mark vocation, custody, or opportunity while leaving response genuinely variable.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the expectation of filtered purity that the following self-wronger productively disrupts.
Supplies selection as an act of choosing, allowing role-selection to remain distinct from final certification.
Keeps a real failure inside the selected set by identifying a right withheld from the self.

changed_reading.before: Being selected appears synonymous with already being morally pure.
changed_reading.after: Selection establishes a charged role or opportunity whose recipients can still answer it badly, adequately, or exceptionally.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Forward movement is explicitly qualified by divine permission, followed by a deictic declaration of great excess or gift.
baseline_models.mechanism: The one ahead acts, but authorization opens the effective route; beneficial advance is therefore neither inert predestination nor autonomous merit. The final deictic can name the surplus bestowed in precedence, the whole differentiated inheritance, or both without forcing one scope.

activation_trace.role: Supplies real initiative and forward movement by the recipient.
Supplies authorization as the enabling condition under which initiative becomes effective.
Supplies an excess or remainder beyond what allocation or need alone would predict.
Supplies unowed benefaction, preventing the final greatness from becoming a wage mechanically earned.
Marks the deictically indicated arrangement as a matter of major consequence.

changed_reading.before: The permission sounds parenthetical and the great bounty sounds like a prize for the fastest class alone.
changed_reading.after: Permission is operationally constitutive, while the great surplus may encompass both enabled precedence and the larger gift of differentiated inheritance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context distributes created capacities and then contrasts what is opened with what is held. That gating sequence revises the triad from conduct alone into conduct operating under differentiated, divinely controlled availability.

activation_trace.role: Keeps the shared inherited resource as the focus-side object whose uptake varies.
Supplies deliberate configuration into differing created conditions rather than undifferentiated sameness.
Supplies expandable capacity, making degree and development part of the contextual field.
Supplies an opened access path through which a resource can become available.
Supplies the opposed operation of retaining or blocking, establishing a genuine gate on availability.

structural_cues: 35:1 presents visibly differentiated capacities before 35:2's balanced opening-and-holding antithesis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies configured difference, increase, opening, and holding; I map that gate to differential activation of the inherited Book. A live alternative is that the opening concerns mercy generally and does not explain the three focus positions.

changed_reading.before: Each class appears to arise solely from an independently chosen quantity of deeds.
changed_reading.after: The classes can also register responses made under unequal but divinely gated capacities, without erasing responsibility for the response.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bad act can be cosmetically improved until its agent sees it as good, while guidance changes direction. The focus self-wronger can therefore fail at evaluation before failing at execution: inherited criterion is present, yet the self misreads its own work.

activation_trace.role: Supplies wrong placement as the focus-side failure now applied to moral perception.
Locates the failure in the self's intention and discernment, not only in outward injury.
Supplies active beautification that can alter how an act presents to its agent.
Keeps the underlying object genuinely bad despite its improved appearance.
Supplies inward judgment, where cosmetic presentation becomes a mistaken reading.
Supplies gentle direction toward the right route as the corrective counterpart to self-misreading.

structural_cues: 35:8 orders the sequence as bad work, beautification, seeing it as good, and then guidance or misguidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a corrupted perception sequence; I identify that sequence as one mechanism of wronging one's own self while holding a Book. The alternative is that 35:8 describes outsiders and only analogically illuminates the selected group.

changed_reading.before: The self-wronger is simply someone with a larger external tally of bad acts.
changed_reading.after: The self-wronger may be an heir whose evaluative apparatus has inverted, causing the inherited norm to be misapplied to his own conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good expression and sound action form a coupled upward process. This gives the focus advance through good things a conversion mechanism: inherited wording does not remain stored but becomes articulated, enacted, and raised.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the written starting material whose practical conversion is at issue.
Supplies forward movement that the context recasts as an upward word-and-work process.
Supplies intelligible utterance as the first active output rather than silent possession.
Supplies intentional practice that couples language to embodied response.
Specifies the practice as repairing rather than corrupting.
Supplies the vertical trajectory that changes generic precedence into ascent.
Supplies the lifting operation joining sound action to ascending expression.

structural_cues: 35:10 places good speech and sound action in one upward syntax rather than listing them as unrelated virtues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upward speech and lifting action; I treat them as the operational route by which a Book-heir moves ahead. The alternative is that 35:10 describes acceptance generally and does not specify the focus triad.

changed_reading.before: Advancing through good things means accumulating more items than the other heirs.
changed_reading.after: Advancing can mean successfully converting inherited language into a coupled ascending practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two bodies remain explicitly unequal, yet each yields nourishment while extraction, adornment, movement, and pursuit of surplus continue. This supplies a model in which real internal asymmetry need not make every non-leading member barren.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the joining medium that keeps unlike members inside one recipient body.
Supplies explicit non-equivalence, preventing the model from flattening the three positions.
Supplies extraction from hidden potential as an output available within unequal conditions.
Adds value-bearing adornment as a second kind of product beyond basic nourishment.
Supplies active passage through a resistant medium, preserving movement despite difference.
Makes surplus the pursued output of movement through the unequal field.

structural_cues: The antithetical pair in 35:12 is followed by a shared 'from each' clause rather than exclusive productivity from only one side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inequality with shared yield; I map the two-source ecology onto the three-member inheritance as a constraint against treating lower position as total sterility. The alternative is that the sea analogy should not be transferred to moral membership.

changed_reading.before: Only the foremost heir can produce value from the inherited Book.
changed_reading.after: The heirs can remain genuinely unequal while more than the leading position still yields real, differently scaled goods.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collective inheritance does not pool moral effects: burdens cannot be shifted, and purification returns to the acting self. The three positions are therefore individually realized relations within a corporate trust, not inherited merit or guilt.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the corporate transgenerational trust whose moral effects must now be distinguished by person.
Supplies a heavy burden and the explicit impossibility of moving it from one bearer to another.
Supplies personal bearing of responsibility rather than transfer of moral load.
Supplies purification as an actual repair whose benefit returns to its agent.
Fixes the return point of purification as the same concrete self named in the focus failure.

structural_cues: 35:18 repeats bearer and burden before closing its purification clause with an explicit reflexive beneficiary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-transfer and reflexive benefit; I use these to separate a collectively inherited office from individually realized status. The alternative is that the focus classes are fixed eschatological groups even though their burdens remain individual.

changed_reading.before: Membership in the selected inheriting body might itself transfer collective merit to every member.
changed_reading.after: The office is shared, but each member personally realizes self-loss, measured fidelity, or advance; neither merit nor burden rides automatically on the inheritance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier communities receive warners and written corpora; the present revealed Book validates what stands before it. The focus inheritance thus becomes a relay of reception, preservation, testing, and confirmation rather than first possession of an isolated object.

activation_trace.role: Supplies succession in knowledge and scripture as the focus-side handoff.
Supplies a messenger-and-message link in the chain of prior reception.
Supplies successive communities as the social units through which transmission passes.
Supplies elapsed generations, giving inheritance an actual predecessor dimension.
Supplies earlier written books as concrete upstream material in the relay.
Repeats the written corpus before the focus inheritance and ties the object to prior delivery.
Supplies the present Book's revelatory arrival immediately before it is inherited.
Supplies fulfillment and confirmation as the operation joining present revelation to prior material.

structural_cues: 35:24-25 universalizes earlier warning and books, while 35:31 immediately precedes the focus with a backward-confirming relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earlier communities, messages, books, elapsed time, present revelation, and confirmation; I connect these into a custodial relay carried by the selected heirs. A live alternative is that inheritance names benefit received, not a duty to continue transmission.

changed_reading.before: The selected people newly possess a self-contained Book.
changed_reading.after: They occupy the current link in a transgenerational validating relay, and their three positions describe how that relay is carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible variation across fruits, rock bands, creatures, and people leads directly to knowledgeable servants whose recognition produces awe. Selection in the focus can therefore preserve differentiated human responses rather than bleaching the selected group into sameness.

activation_trace.role: Keeps deliberate selection as the focus-side operation now constrained by contextual diversity.
Supplies divergence into distinct routes and gives difference a directional rather than merely decorative force.
Supplies differentiated kinds in the immediately preceding natural display.
Supplies awe as a response generated within the field of knowledge.
Links knowledgeable response to the same serving population from which the focus heirs are selected.
Supplies disclosed understanding as one mechanism that differentiates response among servants.

structural_cues: The color-difference sequence of 35:27-28 narrows to servants, knowledge, and awe only four verses before the focus partition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated variation and then knowledgeable servants; I read the focus triad as a human response-spectrum continuous with that variation. The alternative is that natural diversity only demonstrates power and does not characterize the selected set.

changed_reading.before: Selection should make the recipients homogeneous, with the triad an awkward exception.
changed_reading.after: The triad can be the expected human variegation of a selected body, with knowledge and awe among the mechanisms that move response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation, established practice, and expenditure put the Book into circulation as a trade that does not go stagnant; full dues are then paid and an increment is added from surplus. Inheritance becomes working capital whose value appears through use, not an heirloom preserved untouched.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an uncontracted grant that functions as initial capital rather than a wage.
Supplies following recitation as the first circulation of the inherited corpus.
Identifies the same written object as the asset being actively read.
Supplies outward expenditure, preventing circulation from being reduced to verbal possession.
Supplies profit-seeking exchange as the explicit economic frame for active response.
Supplies the threatened stagnation-to-ruin that this particular trade escapes.
Supplies full settlement without deficit as the first return on circulation.
Adds growth beyond full settlement and creates an explicit surplus layer.
Names the increment as benefaction rather than a mechanically owed commercial return.

structural_cues: 35:29-30 forms an input-to-return sequence immediately before the confirming Book and its inheritance in 35:31-32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Book-use, spending, trade, non-stagnation, full payment, and added benefaction; I treat inheritance as entrusted capital activated by those practices. The alternative is that the economic language describes reward only and should not characterize the inherited object.

changed_reading.before: Inheriting the Book means possessing and preserving a prestigious object.
changed_reading.after: Inheriting the Book means putting a granted asset into recitative, ritual, and social circulation so that it yields full return plus unowed increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the selected heirs are partitioned, the next unit continues with an unqualified plural entering, being adorned, and settling in an abode explicitly attributed to benefaction. This keeps alive an inclusive reading in which internal inequality does not automatically split the heirs into different final destinations.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the nearest explicit plural body available as antecedent for the following entrants.
Supplies collective entry without internally restating or narrowing the three focus groups.
Supplies arrival and settled occupancy as the destination of the continuing plural.
Supplies durable residence, turning the destination into stable accommodation rather than a passing reward.
Attributes the settled destination to benefaction and links it back to the focus declaration.

structural_cues: 35:33 immediately resumes with plural verbal morphology and no overt subject reset after the threefold partition in 35:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate plural continuity, entry, settlement, and repeated benefaction; I take the selected heirs as the nearest antecedent. A materially live alternative is an implicit narrowing to the foremost or otherwise successful subset.

changed_reading.before: The three labels necessarily encode three separate final destinations.
changed_reading.after: They may encode unequal conditions within one inheriting population whose plural destination remains inclusive, though pronoun scope is not decisive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The world is actively held from displacement under patience and covering, then a received warning produces not the promised guidance but increased aversion. The focus triad can thus be a maintained but dynamic response system in which receipt may move a member forward, leave one measured, or amplify retreat.

activation_trace.role: Keeps effective forward response dependent on authorization rather than mere exposure.
Supplies active holding that maintains a system despite its tendency toward displacement.
Supplies movement away from an established state as the instability being restrained.
Supplies patient self-restraint as a reason mixed responses are not immediately terminated.
Supplies covering of fault and protection from its immediate effect within the maintained field.
Supplies the same warning stimulus before and after the response reversal.
Supplies the recipients' promised directional response to that stimulus.
Supplies amplification, showing that reception can intensify an existing orientation.
Supplies the actual movement away, reversing the promised direction toward guidance.

structural_cues: 35:42 repeats the arrival of the same warner on both sides of a promise-to-reversal sequence, immediately after 35:41's holding imagery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maintenance, patience, fault-covering, one repeated stimulus, expected guidance, and actual amplified aversion; I treat the focus labels as dynamic trajectories within that held field. The alternative is that the three labels are final types and 35:42 concerns a separate population only.

changed_reading.before: Receiving revelation fixes a recipient's class immediately and uniformly.
changed_reading.after: Reception enters a maintained response system: the same disclosure can be activated toward advance or amplified into retreat, while patience leaves room for nonfinal states.

context_deltas.mechanism: A harmful scheme descends upon and encloses its own people within a stable recurring pattern. This supplies a causal account of the focus reflexive: wrongdoing may travel outward socially, yet its consequence curves back onto the self and its own affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the initial deprivation of a right whose loss is borne by the wrongdoer.
Names the concrete self as the return point of the harmful process.
Supplies harm generated by the outward scheme rather than a merely private defect.
Supplies the return-and-enclosure operation by which harm settles around its source.
Locates the enclosing consequence in the scheme's own group of belonging.
Supplies a recurring path, making reflexive return a stable pattern rather than an accidental episode.

structural_cues: 35:43 repeats the harmful scheme around a verb of enclosure and then repeats the unchanging pattern language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward harm, enclosure of its own people, and recurrence; I use that directional loop to explain how focus wrongdoing is 'for' the self. The alternative is that the loop applies only to the specific schemers of 35:43.

changed_reading.before: Wronging oneself is a private inward fault with no social mechanism.
changed_reading.after: It can be a social action whose stable feedback loop encloses its source, making outward harm reflexively self-depriving.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare fire-related branch of inheritance and cross-maps it to an ecological stirring sequence. It remains anchored in the focus transfer verb and in 35:9's movement from stirring to revival, producing a real possession-versus-activation distinction. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy, not replace the ordinary inheritance sense or equate the three classes with literal combustion stages.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inheritance verb has an ember-stirring branch, while the inherited Book can visibly remain more or less activated in its recipients.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the unusual operation of stirring latent heat into flame and anchors the activation image in the focus verb.
Supplies active disturbance of a latent medium as the first contextual activation step.
Supplies directed driving, converting initial stirring into movement toward a target.
Supplies an inert receiving field that possesses potential but shows no active life.
Supplies revival of dry growth and completes the latent-to-active material sequence.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance is completed when the Book changes hands.
changed_reading.after: Inheritance can deliver latent material whose actual ignition or revival differs among recipients; possession and activation are separate events.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant and surprising because it places the writing-contract branch beside the owned-servant branch, then hears freedom under the same contextual root that surfaces as silk. The reading remains anchored in Book, servants, adornment, release, and settlement, but downstream prose must present it only as a social-legal resonance, never as a claim that the surface words lexically mean manumission or freedom here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly juxtaposes a Book with servants, and its inventories contain the paired images of an emancipation contract and owned service.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a written agreement through which an owned servant can move toward release.
Supplies the owned-servant relation that makes the contract image socially coherent.
Supplies the surface-appropriate fine garment at the adorned destination.
Supplies a freedom resonance under the same root, functioning only as a secondary release image.
Supplies removal of a restriction and lets the exploratory contract image terminate in release.

changed_reading.before: The Book is only a prestigious object handed to already defined servants.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch resonance, the Book can look like a written route by which owned servants are moved toward release, adornment, and settled belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates distributive and registry branches rather than the ordinary spiritual vocabulary. It remains focus-anchored in selection, the repeated internal partition, and declared surplus, and it clarifies why inclusion can precede unequal shares. Downstream prose should label it an allocative analogy, not infer a hidden legal apportionment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Selection, registry, repeated partition, and surplus all occur inside the focus's own lexical and grammatical field.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a specially reserved share designated before general division.
Supplies enrollment in a register and makes common inclusion administratively prior to allocation.
Supplies the remainder beyond division and gives the final declaration an allocative surplus texture.
Supplies a measured middle allocation between excess and deficiency.

changed_reading.before: Selection and the threefold division are unrelated devotional descriptions.
changed_reading.after: They can form an allocative image: a body is reserved and enrolled first, then internally differentiated, while surplus remains a gift beyond the shares.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the pursuit-and-escape edge of precedence. It remains anchored in the focus's forward mover and in 35:44's explicit denial that anything can evade divine reach; the contrast sharply qualifies agency. Downstream prose should present it as spatial counter-imagery, not redefine doing good as fleeing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus mover is ahead only through good things and by permission, while the later context denies autonomous outstripping of divine pursuit.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the edge case of getting beyond a pursuer and opens a chase geometry around precedence.
Constrains focus movement as authorized advance rather than self-created escape.
Supplies escape by outstripping pursuit precisely where the context denies that relation to any creature.
Supplies accumulated strength that still fails to create autonomous evasion.

changed_reading.before: The foremost member simply outruns everyone by personal strength.
changed_reading.after: True precedence is motion within divine permission and toward goods; the surrounding chase geometry blocks reading it as autonomous escape or superiority.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it supplies a causal arrow from suspended seizure to the possibility of a legacy. It remains anchored in the focus inheritance and in 35:45's taking, leaving, and appointed delay. Downstream prose should qualify it as a temporal systems inference, not claim that 35:45 directly defines the focus inheritance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A later generation can inherit only if something and someone are allowed to remain across the interval separating predecessor from heir.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the predecessor-to-heir transfer that requires temporal survival of a remainder.
Supplies immediate seizure for wrongdoing as the counterfactual operation that would interrupt continuity.
Supplies a remaining trace after departure and makes persistence across time available to the inference.
Supplies what a predecessor leaves behind as the most direct branch bridge to inherited material.
Supplies the deferred time boundary that permits continuity before final reckoning.

changed_reading.before: The Book's inheritance is a timeless transfer unrelated to divine forbearance.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory systems reading, delayed seizure creates the temporal remainder through which a legacy and a later inheriting body can exist at all.

strongest_changes: The selected heirs remain one recipient body, while the context turns their three labels into dynamic and individually accountable response positions rather than inherited merit.
Earlier books, present confirmation, recitation, expenditure, non-stagnating trade, full settlement, and added benefaction make inheritance a transgenerational working relay.
Immediate plural continuation into entry and settled benefaction keeps an inclusive destination for the internally unequal heirs genuinely live.
Opening and holding, guidance and amplified aversion, and explicit permission make response effective through a maintained and gated system rather than autonomous capacity alone.
summary.what_was_special: Rare but anchored branches generated several non-collapsible readings: inheritance as latent ignition, Book-and-servants as a contained manumission resonance, selection as reserved allocation, precedence constrained by failed escape, and divine delay as the temporal condition for legacy. These remain exploratory alongside the stronger custodial, perceptual, economic, and inclusive models.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of the final deictic can be the foremost advance, the whole threefold inheritance, or both.
The plural subject after the focus most naturally continues the selected heirs, but an implicit narrowing to a successful subset remains possible.
The three positions may be dynamic trajectories, stable character types, or context-dependent mixtures of both.
The material and social outliers are branch activations and causal analogies, not replacements for the surface lexical senses.

baseline.text: Sonra kitabı kullarımızdan seçtiklerimize miras verdik. Onlardan kimi kendine haksızlık eder, kimi orta yolu tutar, kimi de Allah'ın izniyle iyi işlerde öne geçer. İşte büyük lütuf budur.

findings.text: Kitap, başarıyla satın alınmış bir mal değil, kişisel performanstan önce gelen ve taşıyıcısına sorumluluk yükleyen karşılıksız bir mirastır.
Aynı miras, onu ölçülü biçimde taşıma ile Allah'ın izniyle iyiliklerde öne götürme arasında dereceli bir etkinlik alanı açar.
Kişinin kendine haksızlığı, miras kalan kitabın sağlayabileceği yararı kendi benliğinden esirgemesi olarak da yorumlanabilir.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Contrasts divine non-wronging with people wronging themselves, while also distributing people into repeated groups.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Joins the revealed Book, divinely given plurality, and the command to race in good deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly parallels Allah's choosing, though it concerns selected prophetic houses rather than heirs of the Book.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its differentiated messengers and repeated group division give only a broad structural parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately preceding verse identifies the revealed Book as truth and grounds the inheritance statement.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Uses self-wronging in a garden account, but not the Book's heirs or their graded response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly names the moderate person, though in the distinct setting of fidelity after deliverance at sea.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The nearby declaration of human succession complements the focus's language of inherited stewardship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names an oppressive people, offering a public counterpart to the focus's self-wronging heir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Divides communities between divine guidance and settled error, echoing differentiated responses among people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its warning that apparent good may harm the self is a limited counterpart to self-wronging.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Uses precedence in good as a contested social measure, unlike the focus's divinely enabled precedence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The shared description of faithful servants is too general to clarify selection or inheritance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Divine preservation of heaven and earth does not materially develop the focus's human inheritance theme.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calls successful believers inheritors, but leaves the inherited object and recipient gradation unspecified.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Commands a race toward forgiveness and calls it Allah's great bounty, closely matching precedence and bounty.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A truthful communication is fixed as a transmissible text, handed on as an inheritance, and entrusted to a differentiated body of recipients.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The transfer can be read simultaneously as inscription, gratuitous grant, succession, and a graded movement in which restraint and precedence are distinct responses to the same trust.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inheritance, register, and succession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A predecessor's possession or knowledge passes to successors, is entered into a durable register, and becomes a trust held in the place of those before them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inheritance from a predecessor (quranic:root_001639:B001/m01); grant without purchase or contract (quranic:root_001639:B002/m01); inheritance of knowledge or scripture (quranic:root_001639:B003/m01); written register (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); succession or replacement (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); what is already present or preceding (quranic:root_001693:B008/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The Book is both property passed on and knowledge placed in custody. The register supplies durability, succession supplies office, and the gratuitous grant excludes acquisition as the basis of authority.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A truthful communication is fixed as a transmissible text, handed on as an inheritance, and entrusted to a differentiated body of recipients.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The transfer can be read simultaneously as inscription, gratuitous grant, succession, and a graded movement in which restraint and precedence are distinct responses to the same trust.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Selection and graded movement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body is purified and selected, then differentiates into one who falls short, one who keeps a middle course, and one who moves ahead.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: purification from admixture (quranic:root_000873:B001/m01); choosing an elite (quranic:root_000873:B002/m01); preference and selection (quranic:root_000452:B002/m01); deliberate choosing of the better (quranic:root_000452:B003/m01); precedence in a race (quranic:root_000671:B001/m01); moderation between extremes (quranic:root_001230:B003/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:32 `ٱصْطَفَيْ/خَيْرَٰتِ/سَابِقٌۢ/مُّقْتَصِدٌ` (ص ف و/خ ي ر/س ب ق/ق ص د).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Selection establishes a common entrusted body but does not erase internal difference. The race and middle-course motifs turn the three classes into distinct modes of movement under one prior act of choosing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (35:31-45) Historical Tracks and Governed Change
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human succession moves along inherited tracks toward an appointed outcome, while the governing pattern itself resists substitution or diversion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Road wear, doctrinal path, alternation, postponement, and arrival turn history into movement whose local occupants change but whose governing route and endpoint remain stable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Traveled way and inherited custom
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Repeated movement wears a recognizable road; later travelers follow it as both physical route and inherited practice.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: customary governing path (quranic:root_000750:B001/m01); journeying through land (quranic:root_000769:B001/m01); way or established custom (quranic:root_000769:B002/m01); path or adopted doctrine (quranic:root_000522:B007/m01); straight directed path (quranic:root_001230:B002/m01); road worn by passage (quranic:root_001046:B011/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The invariant pattern is not only a rule but a traveled way made legible by repetition. Physical journey, moral direction, and inherited custom remain distinguishable while explaining why earlier outcomes can instruct later occupants.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Intended action accrues to its agent and returns as a consequence that can increase rank or compound loss.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Commerce, growth, precedence, and earned acquisition make consequence cumulative and agent-bound rather than a single externally imposed event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Increase, advantage, and compounded loss
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A position can grow into surplus and precedence, while a losing transaction compounds the deficit already attached to its agent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: general loss or diminution (quranic:root_000409:B001/m01); commercial loss (quranic:root_000409:B002/m01); increase and growth (quranic:root_000657:B001/m01); surplus beyond sufficiency (quranic:root_001163:B001/m01); advantage or higher degree (quranic:root_001163:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Increase and loss are directional accumulations, not binary verdicts. The trade sense of loss makes disbelief a worsening account, while surplus and degree show the opposite possibility of value exceeding its starting measure.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin önceki sahibinden akrabalık ya da başka bir hak sebebiyle sonrakilere geçmesini; özellikle ölümden sonra malın mirasçıya kalmasını anlatır. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu aktarım yönünü ve miras ilişkisini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, miras bırakan ile mirasçı arasındaki geçişle sınırlıdır; karşılıksız her verme, bilgi aktarımı ve ateşle ilgili ayrı kullanım buna dahil değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel miras geçişini temel alır; belirli fiil yapıları ile kuşaktan kuşağa aktarım anlatımını bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir malın ya da başka bir edinilmiş değerin önceki sahibinden, akrabalık veya geçerli başka bir sebep dolayısıyla mirasçıya geçmesidir. Miras sözü, önceki kuşaktan kalan kökeni veya kalıntıyı da gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey önce bir kişiye veya topluluğa aitken akrabalık ya da başka bir hak sebebiyle sonrakilere geçer.
Bir kimsenin ölümü üzerine malı, onun mirasçısı olan kişiye kalır.
Önceki kuşaktan kalan köken veya kalıntı da miras olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, edinilmiş bir şeyin önceki sahibinden sonrakine sözleşmeyle kurulan yeni bir alışveriş olmadan geçmesidir; ölüm sonrası mal geçişi bunun belirgin örneğidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Malın veya başka bir edinilmiş değerin önceki sahibinden hak sahibi ardılına geçtiği dalın bütün çekirdek bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki sahip, ardıl mirasçı ve aralarındaki miras yoluyla geçiş birlikte korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım, mirasçı açısından kuruluyor ve malın ya da değerin kimden geçtiği belirtiliyorsa doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Mirasçının önceki sahibinden bir değer edinmesi ve aktarım yönü korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Önceki kuşaktan kalan kökenin, kalıntının veya değerin kendisi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki kuşaktan kalma niteliğini ve kalan şeyin miras oluşunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı malın mirasçıya yönelen geçişini kurar; komşu dal ise bu malı ölenin bıraktığı toplam olarak adlandırır. Bu nedenle nesne alanı kesişse de bakış açısı ve çekirdek ilişki aynı değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mirasçının önceki sahibinden bir mal veya değer edinmesiyle sonuçlanan geçiş.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir başkasını mirasa dahil etme, ona pay bırakma veya bir şeyi ona emeksizce kazandırma.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı miras aktarımını karşıt katılımcı yönlerinden ele alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı mirasın ardıla geçmesini ve ardılın edinmesini öne çıkarır; komşu dal geçişi sağlayan ya da başkasını pay sahibi kılan ettirgen katılımcıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mal veya başka bir edinilmiş değerin hukuki ya da soy bağına dayalı miras olarak geçmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bilgi, erdem veya peygamberlik gibi maddi olmayan bir değerin önceki taşıyıcıdan sonrakine miras benzetmesiyle aktarılması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir değer önceki taşıyıcıdan sonraki taşıyıcıya geçer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı olağan miras ilişkisini ve özellikle mal geçişini kapsar; komşu dal aynı aktarım şemasını maddi olmayan bilgi ve erdem alanına taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşu kartları değerlendirildi. Seçilen üç karşılaştırma, mirasın geride kalan maldan, ettirgen miras bırakmadan ve maddi olmayan bilgi aktarımından ayrıldığı başlıca sınırları gösterir; öteki adaylar yalnızca uzak bir mal, akrabalık veya pay alanını paylaşır.
branches.branch_image_ar: انتقال ميراث من سابق إلى وارث
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الورث والميراث والإرث والتراث، ووراثة المال أو الشيء عن الأب أو الميت، وصيرورة مال المورث للوارث بنسب أو سبب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تحريك جمر النار، ولا مجرد اسم بني الورثة، ولا صفة البقاء الإلهي إلا من جهة رجوع الملك.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أن يكون الشيء لقوم ثم يصير إلى آخرين بنسب أو سبب (maqayis)؛ ورثت أبي وورثت الشيء من أبي (sihah)؛ ورث فلان أباه، ورثت فلانا مالا إذا مات مورثك فصار ميراثه لك (tahdhib)؛ الوراثة والإرث انتقال قنية إليك عن غيرك من غير عقد، وإرث أبيكم أي أصله وبقيته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir başkasını mirasçı veya malda pay sahibi kılmayı, bir şeyi ona miras bırakmayı ve ayrıca bir kimsenin bir şeye emek çekmeden kavuşmasını birlikte verir. Provisional çerçevedeki sözleşmesizlik ve külfetsizlik, dalın bütün ettirgen örneklerine değil özellikle emeksiz edinim uzantısına sınır olarak uygulanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, başkasına miras bırakma veya onu mirasa dahil etmedir; emeksiz edinim ise belirli anlatımlara bağlı bir uzantıdır ve her türlü armağanı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel ettirgen miras bırakma anlamı ile belirli bir yapıda görülen emeksizce elde etme anlamı ayrı tutulur; ikinci anlam yalın biçimin tamamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka birine miras bırakmak ya da onu malda pay sahibi kılarak mirasa dahil etmektir. Belirli bir anlatımda, bir kimsenin emek harcamadan sevindirici bir şeye kavuşmasını da ifade eder.

facets.statement: Bir kimse, başka birinin bir şeyi miras edinmesini sağlar veya o şeyi ona miras bırakır.
Bir kişi, kendi malında başkasına pay ayırarak onu miras çevresine dahil eder.
Bir kimsenin emek harcamadan hoş bir şeye kavuşması, miras edinme biçiminde anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, bir şeyi başkasına miras bırakma veya bir kişiyi malda pay sahibi kılma yönündedir; aynı toplu kanıt emeksiz ve hoş bir edinimi anlatan özel kullanımı da içerir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Başkasını mirasa dahil eden ettirgen çekirdeği ve belirli yapıdaki emeksiz edinim uzantısını birlikte özetlemek gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem başkasını mirasçı kılma yönünü hem de emeksiz edinim uzantısını ayrı seçenekler olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir malın veya başka bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye miras olarak bırakılması anlatılıyorsa kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen katılımcıyı, bırakılan şeyi ve miras yoluyla kazanan kişiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kendi malında başka birine miras payı ayırması açıkça anlatılıyorsa uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi mal çevresine dahil etme ve ona pay ayırma işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özne bir şeye çaba göstermeden kavuşuyor ve anlatım bunu miras edinmeye benzetiyorsa kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Edinimin çabasız oluşunu ve öznenin elde eden konumunu korur.
Bir şeyi karşı tarafa kazandıran verici yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Miras ilişkisi bulunmayan her türlü gönüllü ve karşılıksız vermeyi de kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Mirasçı kılma ile sıradan armağan verme arasındaki sınırı siler.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı miras aktarımı, veren ve alan katılımcı yönlerinden görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında ettirgen kişi aktarımı sağlar ya da payı belirler; komşu dalda ise geçişin sonucu ve mirasçının edinimi çekirdektir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Miras koşulu aramadan genel olarak birine mal veya başka bir şey verme ve onu malik kılma.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda alıcı, doğrudan bir bedel ödemeden bir şey kazanabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının ayırt edici bağı miras veya mirasta paydır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise miras olması gerekmeyen karşılıksız armağandır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مال الميت من جهة القسمة العائلية المحضة، ولا وراثة العلم والكتاب، ولا مجرد البقاء بعد الفناء.
branches.source_phrase_ar: يصير إلى آخرين بنسب أو سبب (maqayis)؛ أورثه الشيء أبوه، ورثه توريثا أي أدخله في ماله على ورثته (sihah)؛ أورث الرجل ولده مالا، ورثت فلانا من فلان أي جعلت ميراثه له (tahdhib)؛ أورثني الله كذا، لكل من حصل له شيء من غير تعب، خول شيئا مهنئا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal ifadesi peygamberlik, bilgi ve erdemin maldan ayrı bir miras gibi geçmesini, bilginlerin peygamberlerin bilgi mirasçıları sayılmasını ve bir öncekinden bilgi edinmeyi destekler. Provisional çerçevedeki kitap kapsamı yalnızca ayrı bir sözcük biriminde tanıklanmıştır; bu nedenle dal tanımının çekirdeğine taşınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın kavram haritası maddi olmayan bilgi, erdem ve peygamberlik aktarımıyla sınırlıdır; kitapla ilgili kullanım yalnızca kendi sözcük biriminde karşılanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Maddi olmayan miras çekirdeği ile bilgi edinme ve bilgi mirasçısı olma yapıları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterilir; kitap kullanımı dal çekirdeğine genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Peygamberlik, bilgi veya erdem gibi maddi olmayan bir değerin önceki taşıyıcıdan sonrakine miras gibi geçmesidir. Bilginin bir öncekinden edinilmesini ve bilginlerin peygamberlerden kalan bilgiyi sürdürmesini kapsar.

facets.statement: Peygamberlik, bilgi veya erdem, maldan farklı olarak önceki taşıyıcıdan sonrakine maddi olmayan bir miras biçiminde geçer.
Bilginler, peygamberlerden kalan bilginin mirasçıları sayılır.
Bir kimseden bilgi edinmek, o bilgiyi ondan miras almak biçiminde anlatılabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal ifadesi Tanrı'nın herkes yok olduktan sonra kalıcı olması ve kulların geçici mülkiyetinin sonunda O'na dönmesi üzerinde durur. Provisional çerçevedeki bir şeyin sahibiyle ölüme kadar kalması, yalnızca ayrı bir sözcük biriminde tanıklanır ve dal çekirdeğinin parçası yapılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tanımı ilahi kalıcılık ve bütün mülkün sonunda Tanrı'ya dönmesiyle sınırlıdır; sıradan insanlar arasındaki miras aktarımını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: İlahi kalıcılık ile mülkün sonunda geri dönmesi dal çekirdeğinde birlikte tutulur; ölüme dek yanında kalma anlatımı yalnızca kendi sözcük biriminde verilir.

facets.statement: Tanrı, kendisi dışındaki varlıklar yok olduktan sonra da kalan ve sürekliliği sona ermeyen varlıktır.
Kulların geçici olarak sahip olduğu şeyler ve bütün varlıklar sonunda Tanrı'ya döner.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korun bir araçla veya elle hareket ettirilip ateşin yeniden canlandırılması anlatılıyorsa kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel eşeleme işlemini ve ateşin yeniden alevlenmesi sonucunu korur.
Ateşin yanar duruma gelmesi sonucunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Kor bulunmadan sıfırdan ateş oluşturmanın bütün yollarını da kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Korun özellikle hareket ettirilmesi işlemini genel tutuşturmayla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Var olan ateşin korunu hareket ettirerek tutuşmayı sağlama işlemi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ateşi genel olarak hareket ettirme veya tutuşturma yanında savaşın kışkırtılmasına ve bunu yapan araca uzanan daha geniş alan.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ateşi fiziksel olarak hareket ettirip yanmayı güçlendirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı var olan kor ve onun tutuşmasıyla sıkı biçimde sınırlıdır; komşu dal genel ateş hareketini, aracı ve savaş uzantısını da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tutuşma amacıyla doğrudan koru hareket ettirme.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Fırın yakma, odunla ateş besleme ve ateşi bir şeye salma gibi daha geniş yakma ve körükleme işlemleri.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ateşin yanmasını başlatma veya güçlendirme eylemini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında ayırt edici işlem korun hareketidir; komşu dal yakıt ekleme, fırın yakma ve genel körüklemeyi de kapsayan daha geniş bir eylem alanına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mevcut koru karıştırarak ateşin yeniden tutuşmasını sağlama.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çakmak taşından gizli ateşi çıkarma veya sönük ateşi genel olarak yakıp yükseltme.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın sonucu ateşin görünür ve etkin hale gelmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı önceden var olan kor üzerinde mekanik bir harekete bağlıdır; komşu dal ateşin çakma yoluyla çıkarılmasını veya sönük ateşin genel olarak yakılmasını anlatır.

source_note.JA: Ateşin korunu hareket ettirerek onun yeniden tutuşmasını sağlama anlamı tanıklanır.

root_profile.summary: Anlam örgüsünün merkezi, bir malın ya da başka bir değerin öncekinden sonrakine geçmesi ve bu geçişin ettirgen yönüdür; bilgi ve erdem aktarımı ile herkes yok olduktan sonra mülkün Tanrı'ya dönmesi bu merkezin soyut ve dinsel uzantılarıdır. Korun hareket ettirilerek ateşin tutuşturulması ise ayrı bir anlam dalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlam çekirdeğini bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp birleştirmek olarak açıkça kurar; deri dikme, hayvanın bazı uzuvlarını bağlama, boncukla tutturma ve birlik oluşturma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğin özelleşmiş gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı yazma ya da hüküm verme anlamını değil, fiziksel veya toplu birleştirme işlemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak birleştirme çekirdeğini korur; dikme, bağlama, kapatma ve birlik düzenleme anlamlarını yalnızca tanıklanmış biçim ve yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, katma ve birleştirme çekirdeğinin dikiş, bağlama, sıkıca kapatma ve düzenli topluluk oluşturma gibi somut uygulamalarda korunmasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazma işlemini, bunun ürünü olan yazılı metin veya sayfayı ve yazdırma, isteme ya da öğretme gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları birlikte tanıklar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı üretimi ve yazılı ürünle sınırlıdır; yazının bağlayıcı hüküm için mecazlaşması ayrı dalda tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yazma işlemi ve yazılı ürün dalın merkezindedir; dikte ettirme, başkasından yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme anlamları yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazılı bir metin oluşturmak ve bu işlemin ürünü olan metin ya da yazılı sayfadır. Birine yazdırma, ondan yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme ise belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, harfleri yazıyla düzenleyip bir metin oluşturmak veya var olan metni kopyalamaktır.
İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.
Bir metni başkasına söyleyerek yazdırmak ve birinden kendisi için yazmasını istemek yapıya bağlı ettirgen ve isteme kullanımlarıdır.
Yazmayı öğretmek, yazı öğretmeni ve öğretim yeri anlamları yazı edinimi alanındaki bağlı kullanımlardır.
Öğretim yerindeki çocuklar veya onların topluluğu için kullanılan biçim, yeri değil öğrencileri gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yazmayı harfleri çizgiyle bir araya getiren işlem olarak sunar; yazılı ürün, kopyalama, dikte ettirme, yazma isteği ve öğretimle ilgili kullanımlar bu merkeze bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem harflerden metin oluşturma işlemini hem de ortaya çıkan yazılı ürünü birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yazı oluşturma işlemi ile yazılı ürün arasındaki temel anlam bağını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yükümlülük, hüküm, paylaştırılmış yazgı veya kesinleşmiş karar olarak belirleme alanını açıkça toplar; burada yazı, harf çizme eylemi değil bağlayıcı biçimde belirlemenin anlatım yoludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Salt yazı yazmak bu dala girmez; belirleme işleminin yükümlülük, hüküm veya yazgı sonucu doğurması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yükümlülük, hüküm ve yazgı değerleri birlikte korunur; birine zorunluluk yükleme ve Tanrı'nın belirlemesi anlamları yalnızca tanıklanmış yapılara bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük, hüküm veya gerçekleşmesi belirlenmiş pay ve yazgı olarak karara bağlamaktır. Yazma çağrışımı burada harf çizmekten çok kararın kesinleştirilip geçerli kılınmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir işi yapılması gereken bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak belirlemek temel değerlerden biridir.
Bir konuda geçerli ve kesinleşmiş hüküm vermek aynı belirleme çekirdeğinin yargısal yönüdür.
Bir olayın payını, ölçüsünü veya gelecekte gerçekleşecek sonucunu önceden belirlemek yazgı yönünü oluşturur.
Yazma anlatımı, belirlenen hükmün saptanmış, yürürlüğe konmuş ve kesinleşmiş olmasını ifade eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükümlülük, hüküm, yazgı, belirleme ve kesinleşmiş karar değerlerini aynı bağlayıcı saptama alanında birleştirir; yazma sözü bu saptamanın anlatım aracıdır.
